package: A7.4 follow a new intern session
title: A new intern session still working over MCP points the chat to where it can follow it
request: The owner: run the full gate and fix what it finds.
spec: A7.4: an intern job started over MCP finishes, and a write longer than the call's wait goes on while the chat is told how to follow it.
plan: Read the failing test and the reply it got
Point the reply at the sessions list
Force the long path to prove it

decisions.decision: The reply for a new intern session names GET /api/intern/sessions
decisions.why: the session's id is not known while the request still runs, and the jobs list does not say which session is the chat's

decisions.decision: The test follows the reply instead of waiting longer
decisions.why: a loaded machine makes the start outlast the wait; that is the product working, so the test does what a chat would

change: dclab_rnd/chat_agents.py (_follow), tests/test_chat_agents.py (the intern test follows a still-working reply).

findings.defect: The intern-over-MCP test failed when the session outlasted the 100 s wait
findings.scenario: The full gate ran while a second full gate ran beside it; the intern session took longer than the call's 100 s wait.
findings.cause: The test expected a finished session from the call itself; the call correctly answered 202, still working.
findings.fix: On a still-working reply the test follows the sessions list until the session ends.
findings.test: tests/test_chat_agents.py test_an_intern_job_started_over_mcp_finishes, also run with the wait cut to 2 s

findings.defect: A still-working new intern session sent the chat to the jobs list
findings.scenario: A chat starts an intern session over MCP and it runs past the wait.
findings.cause: The follow hint had a case for an existing session's path but not for creating one, so it fell back to GET /api/jobs, which does not name the session.
findings.fix: The hint for POST /api/intern/sessions names GET /api/intern/sessions, where the session is listed with its id and status.

outcome: The intern test passes whether the session ends within the wait or after it, and a chat is told where its new session is.
lessons: A test of a call with a time limit should cover the answer given after the limit, not only the quick one.
risks: The test may now take several minutes on a loaded machine; it gives up after 15 minutes.
